_meta: Single source of truth for every chart surface: the MT5 terminal chart (native MQL5 objects), the Telegram trade-event + /chart PNG renders (service/app/render.py), the dashboard (service/app/static/dashboard.html) and the Telegram mini-app (service/app/static/miniapp.html). One palette, one set of indicator parameters. Colors are stored as #RRGGBB hex; each renderer derives its own format from app.chart_spec (matplotlib rgba, CSS hex, and MQL C'R,G,B' literals). S/R zones are outline-only everywhere: unblended border color, no fill. Filled trade-box colors remain pre-blended on MT5 because MT5 chart objects cannot be translucent -- the parity test re-derives those literals with blend(base, theme.background, alpha). Change a colour or parameter here, not in a renderer. When changing this file, update mt5/Include/XauAssistant (SrBoxes.mqh / TradeBoxes.mqh / Strategies/HalfTrendEma.mqh) and recompile the EA in MetaEditor on Windows.
